name: phd-skills
title_zh: 只认论文复现、实验设计、审稿、对比四件事的科研助手
tagline_zh: 在 Claude Code 里跑通论文代码、设计对照实验、写审稿意见、比结果——不碰文献综述，不写基金本子。
tagline_en: Reproduce code, design controlled experiments, write review comments, compare results in Claude Code—no lit.
desc_en: PhD Research Skills for Claude Code: paper reproduction, experiment design, paper review, result comparison and more.
why_zh: 按科研流程拆步骤，每一步有检查点，防止你漏掉基线或统计检验。
why_en: Breaks tasks into research workflow steps with checkpoints, catching missing baselines or statistical tests before you finalize.
limit_zh: 只覆盖论文复现、实验设计、审稿、结果对比四类任务；不处理文献综述、基金申请、论文润色。需要 Claude Code 环。
limit_en: Only covers paper reproduction, experiment design, review, and result comparison; no lit review, grants, or polishing. Requires Claude Code and.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: Research copilot for paper reproduction, experiment.
